VI.description: Attaches (fAttach non-zero) or detaches (0) the input processing of thread idAttach to that of thread idAttachTo through user32.dll AttachThreadInput (stdcall\2C called in LabVIEW's UI thread). While attached\2C both threads share one key state\2C so user32 SetKeyboardState.vi called in the UI thread writes the key state the other thread reads. return value is the Win32 BOOL\3A non-zero on success. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: The thread to attach (LabVIEW's UI thread\2C kernel32 GetCurrentThreadId.vi).
The thread to attach it to (the target window's thread\2C user32 GetWindowThreadProcessId.vi).
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.
